Commentary.Commentary: A target in excess of 300 is always tough to overhaul and with the pitch behaving on the slower side, it won't be easy for Bangladesh. They are also without Shakib and Liton, who were in good form of late, and will have to plan this chase really carefully. Lasith Malinga, in his last match, would definitely come hard at them and will unleash all his variations one last time. Promises to be an exciting run chase. Do join us in a short while.

The less said about Bangladesh the better. It seemed as if they were still tired from their World Cup campaign. Their bowling was not that good at the start and their fielding was lethargic too. At one stage it seemed that Sri Lanka would cross the 350-run mark but the Tigers managed to pull things back a bit in the latter part of the innings. The pick of the bowlers for them would be Shafiul Islam who was a tad bit expensive but did take 3 wickets. Once again Soumya Sarkar proved his worth with the ball, just like he did during the recently concluded World Cup, and bowled five tidy overs where he bagged the prized scalp of the centurion.

In spite of bowling well in the last 10 overs, it's a big target in front of Bangladesh. Initially, the Lankans did not get off to the best of starts as they lost Fernando early on. But then, Kusal Perera alongwith skipper Dimuth Karunaratne took charge of the innings. They made a 97-run stand for the 2nd wicket which laid the foundation for the batsmen coming in. Kusal Perera completed a 100-run stand with Kusal Mendis as well before departing for 111 off 99 balls. Kusal Mendis and Angelo Mathews also played good knocks of 43 and 48 runs respectively. Lasith Malinga also came out to bat to a loud cheer and a standing ovation in his final ODI.
69/4 in the last 10 overs and Bangladesh will be really happy with their work at the death. They bowled very accurately and didn't allow the Lankan batsmen to score freely.

A quick interview first up with Kusal Perera! Says that he opened the batting during the World Cup and today he batted at 3, as the situation was different. Adds that he backs his strength and that's why he is scoring runs. Mentions that during the practice sessions, it's always about hard work for him. Feels that they can defend this total and varying the pace will be the key on this slow surface. Tells that it's really hot and humid and he is feeling tired. Informs that he will be keeping in spite of that.

Malinga makes 6 and returns to the pavilion amidst a huge ovation as if he has scored a double century! He is loved so much in this part of the world. Islam angles in a length ball on middle, Malinga drags his shot off the inner half to wide long on and collects a couple of runs. Sri Lanka finish on 314/8!
Width on offer outside off, once again Lasith swings his bat but only to miss.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, Malinga tries his best to flick but misses.
Slower one outside off, Lasith swings and misses this time.
Big cheer again from the crowd. Malinga meets the ball from the middle of his bat. He strokes it through extra cover and gets another couple. His friends and family are loving it.
Nuwan Pradeep is in next.

OUT! Another catch taken by Sabbir in the deep. Dhananjaya aims to go downtown this time. It's a length ball in the line of the stumps, de Silva gets behind it and launches it over mid on. But there isn't enough distance on this shot. The long on fielder doesn't move an inch. It falls straight down to his throat. Wicket number 8 goes down for Sri Lanka.

FOUR! Brilliantly played! After the shot, Malinga is seen advising something to Dhananjaya. A low full toss on middle and leg, de Silva picks it off his pads and whips it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
The crowd goes mad as Malinga opens his account. Smiles all around in the Sri Lankan camp. Slinga has swung this length ball over mid-wicket and has picked up a couple of runs.
Play and a miss! Rahman angles across a length ball outside off, Lasith pushes inside the line and misses.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.

Huge reception from the crowd! Lasith Malinga walks in to bat. Mathews hugs him on his way back. Mr. Percy Abeysekera (Sri Lankan cricket's biggest fan) is escorting the Slinga to the middle of the ground and is waving the Lankan flag. Absolute scenes out there. The spectators are flashing their mobile lights.

OUT! Mathews holes out! No fifty for Mathews and he returns disappointed. Full and on off, once again no pace to work with, Mathews hangs on the back foot and tries to muscle it over long off. But he fails to gather enough power behind his shot and Sabbir Rahman runs forward from the deep to take a fine low catch.

A good looking shot but it will also fetch them only a run. Slightly short and on off, de Silva bends his back knee and rotates his wrists to turn it over mid-wicket. It goes on one bounce to the fielder in the deep and the batsmen take one.
Delivers it very full and on off, not much pace on offer, Mathews stays back and goes hard at it. Still only manages a single by forcing it down to long off.
Wow. DdS gets ready, well in advance, to play the reverse sweep. But the ball comes months later than he intended to and misses.
Works this through mid-wicket with subtle wrists for a single. 300 UP FOR SRI LANKA.
Outside off, worked through mid-wicket for a brace.
Outside off, driven towards long off for a run.

MISFIELD, FOUR! This is spreading like an epidemic. A length ball, around middle, de Silva flicks it stylishly towards deep square leg. Mehidy Hasan gets across to his left from fine leg, slides but the ball bounces off his left elbow into the fence behind. He gets up, tries to pull the ball back but pulls the ropes in.
Full and around off, pushed through mid on for a single.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run. 10 from the over.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
WIDE. Another slower bouncer, outside off, DdS looks to ramp it again but misses. No appeal this time.

WIDE. A short ball outside off, de Silva looks to ramp it out towards third man but is beaten by the lack of pace on that one. Rahim appeals for the catch but instead of the finger going up the arms are stretched sideways.
A length ball outside off, DdS looks to flick but the ball goes off the inner half towards short fine leg.

Deliberate or edgy? A length ball outside off, Dhananjaya looks to steer it to third man but the ball goes off the outside edge past Rahim towards third man. A couple taken this time. Wait. Replays show that Dhananjaya did not ground his bat while turning for the second. In fact, his bat touched the ground outside the crease. A SHORT RUN SIGNALLED.
FOUR! Edged away! A length ball outside off, de Silva swings hard but the ball flies off the outside edge, past the diving keeper, to the third man fence.

Another misfield. Bangladesh have been very lazy today. That is the softest term that can be coined. Full and around off, almost a yorker, Mathews digs it out back to the bowler. Mustafizur gets his left hand down to stop but is lazy to bend further. A single down to long on.
Misfield! Shortish and wide outside off, Mathews cuts it towards point where Mahmudullah misfields and allows a single. 6 runs and a wicket from the over.
Hangs on the back foot and strokes it firmly down to long on for one.

Stifled appeal for an lbw! Islam spears in a very full ball on middle, Mathews tries working it on the leg side but gets a faint inside edge onto the pads. The bowler appeals and the batsmen cross. No signal from the umpire, confirming that it came off the bat.
Fullish and on middle, it's worked wide of mid on for a couple of runs.
Dhananjaya de Silva walks in at number 8, replacing Thisara.

OUT! A big breakthrough as Thisara Perera can prove to be really dangerous at this stage of an innings. Shafiul takes the pace off this delivery and bowls it just outside off. Thisara tries to power it over covers but ends up slicing it off the outer half of his blade. It balloons in the air and Soumya Sarkar runs across to his right from sweeper cover to complete the catch. Thisara trudges back.
Angling down the leg side, it's picked up off the pads and clipped through square leg for one.
A bouncer to end the over, TP ducks. 8 runs and a wicket from the over, Mustafizur's figures read 8-0-60-1.
Around off, flicked through square leg where Mehidy Hasan dives to his right but misses. He hurts his knee in the process. A single taken.
Outside off, pushed through the covers for a run.
Carnage time. Thisara Perera time. How many sixes?

OUT! Caught! The foot is fine and Thirimanne has to resume his long walk. A short ball outside off, Lahiru fetches this via a pull and gets it over mid-wicket. He does not have enough strength on it and Soumya Sarkar runs to his left in the deep to complete the formalities. Thirimanne looks at the heavens and walks off but then he is asked to wait as the umpires suspect a possible overstepping. The replays are touch and go but eventually LT has to go. The 60-run stand is broken.
Thirimanne has been caught! But he is asked to wait. Is that an overstepping? Here come the replays... oops.. oops.. oops andddddddddddddddddddd... the Fizz has something behind the line!
Full and outside off, punched through the covers for a single.

FOUR! Wonderful use of the feet by Angelo Mathews. After 7 overs, they finally get one to the fence. A length ball outside off, Angelo comes down the track and clobbers it right back over the bowlers's head. One bounce and into the sightscreen.
Too full in length and on middle, Thirimanne works it wide of mid on and returns for the second run.
Mishit! Full and outside off, Mathews tries to drive it through covers but ends up slicing it off the outer half. The sweeper cover fielder stops it to his left and the batsmen switch ends.
Pitches it up and around off, Thirimanne knocks it down to long on for one. Good over so far by Shafiul, only 4 coming off it!
Mathews works it with the angle of the bowler. He just tickles it in the gap at mid-wicket for one.

In the air but safe! 50-run stand comes up! Islam lands it on a length and outside off, Lahiru reaches out for it and chips it over extra cover. The long off fielder runs across to his right to collect the ball and the batsmen take a brace.
Another wide! This time Thirimanne gives the charge but once again the line from the bowler is way wide outside off.
Wide! Slips a full ball wide outside off, Thirimanne leaves it alone.
Shafiul Islam returns. 5-0-31-1 so far.
A length ball outside off, swung over mid-wicket for one more.
Full and outside off, chipped down to long off for a run.
WIDE. This is definitely a wide. A bouncer, around middle, Angelo bails out of the pull shot.
Full and outside off, AM comes down the track and slashes hard but misses. Rahim starts to appeal but then angrily looks at his bowler. Wonder why? Because he did not appeal?
A length ball outside off, Angelo looks to heave but miscues it over mid on. A couple taken.
Around off, punched straight to cover.
Full and around middle, Thirimanne comes down the track and skews it off the inner half down to long on. A single taken.
Mustafizur Rahman is back to bowl at the death.
Flatter and on off, Mathews hangs on the back foot and punches it on the leg side. Finds short mid-wicket. 5 from the over, a very good one at any stage of the game, forget the death stage.
Flighted and on off, Lahiru leans and works it past the mid-wicket fielder for a run.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Goes hard at it and drags it off the inside half of his bat to deep mid-wicket. A single added to the total.
Strides on the front foot and pushes it to covers.

Misfield! Short in length and around off, Thirimanne cuts it towards point where the fielder is lazy to get down and it goes behind for a couple of runs. 250 up for Sri Lanka! The last 50 took the most number of balls than the other four.
Eases this through mid on for a run.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Short and outside off, cut behind point for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Full and around off, pushed through mid on. Mathews stretches his hamstring and comes back for the second.
On a length around off, pushed back to the bowler.
POWERPLAY 3 time. 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end now.
Shorter on off stump, Thirimanne cuts it to cover for a brace.
Loopy delivery on middle stump, Mathews plays it to long on for another single.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a single.
Flatter delivery on middle Mathews pushes it to mid on for a single.
Around off, worked through mid on for a single.
Shortish delivery on middle stump, Mathews pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball on off stump, Thirimanne jumps down the track and gets an inside edge. No run.
Back of a length delivery, Mathews pulls it to mid-wicket where the fielder dives to make the stop.
Short ball on middle, Thirimanne guides it to third man for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short ball on off stump, Thirimanne makes room and smashes it but straight to the cover fielder.
Good length delivery on off stump, Thirimanne pushes it to cover. No run.
Flatter and fuller on middle and leg, eased to long on for a single.
Rubel Hossain is back on.
Gets forward to a full ball and helps it through covers for one.
Advances down the track to a full ball and strokes it to long on for one.
Spinning down leg, helped wide of short fine leg for one.
Shorter in length outside off stump, Thirimanne rocks back and  square cuts it past the cover fielder for a single.
Loopy delivery on off stump, Thirimanne defends it to the off side.
Mehedi Hasan is back into the attack.

OUT OFF A FREE HIT! Low full toss outside off stump, Mathews bends his knees and tries to hit above the mid off fielder but goes straight in the hands of Tamim. Can't be given out as it was a free hit. And they do not cross for a run.
Free Hit time!
NO BALL! Mustafizur oversteps and bowls a length ball outside off, Mathews plays it straight to cover.
FOUR! Another pull from Mathews to the same area. Mustafizur keeps on bowling short and Angelo does not miss out again. He pulls it past the mid-wicket fielder for the second boundary of the over.
A short ball, punched straight to cover.
FOUR! What a shot from Mathews. First boundary for Mathews. It was short on middle stump. Mathews rocks back and pulls it to the deep mid-wicket fence. Poor ball from Rahman.
Good length ball on off stump, Mathews pushes it past the cover fielder for a brace.
Full delivery on off stump, Mathews pushes it back to the bowler.
Full and around off, pushed through to long on for a single.
Another good length ball, Mathews flicks it again to the mid-wicket fielder. No run.
Good length ball on middle, Mathews flicks it to the leg side and takes off but Thirimanne sends him back.
Short ball outside off stump, Mathews pushes it to cover for a dot ball.
Short ball outside off stump, Thirmimanne guides it to third man for a single.
On a length outside off, pushed towards point.
Another good length delivery on the pads, Thirimanne flicks it towards leg side for a single.
Length ball pitching on off drifting into Lahiru, he blocks it out towards mid off.

FOUR! Good start to Thirimanne's innings. It was a good length delivery outside off. Thirimanne plays his trademark shot towards the covers where it goes through the gap for a  boundary. This boundary has come after along time for the Lankans.
Back of a length delivery on middle pole, Mathews flicks it towards mid on and takes off for a quick single.
BEATEN! Good length ball outside off stump, Mathews goes for a drive but is unable to put any bat on it.
Short delivery on middle, Mathews blocks it back to the bowler.
The new batsman in for Sri Lanka is Lahiru Thirimanne. There is a change in bowling as well as Mustafizur is back into the attack.

OUT! Good period of play for Bangladesh. Two set batsmen have been removed from the crease. Back of a length delivery in the channel outside off, Mendis' feet are glued inside the crease as he throws his bat at it. The ball appears to have taken the faintest of edges on its way to the keeper who gathers the ball. No real appeal there as both the keeper and the bowler thought it missed the bat by a whisker. But...but...but... wait a second, Kusal Mendis WALKS! What an honest batsman! The Ultra Edge confirms there was some involvement of bat.
Mathews drives this full ball down the ground and gives Mendis the strike.
Mathews plays this good length ball towards mid off.
Wide. Bouncer but way too high. It is bowled on middle and leg, and Mathews lets it go.
Another one on the pads of Mendis this time, he flicks this one towards deep square leg for a single.
On the pads of Mathews, he flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Length ball on off, it hits the inside half of Mathews blade and goes back to the bowler.
Another short delivery on the body, Mathews pulls it to the leg side for a single. Mathews is off the mark.
Good short delivery to welcome Mathews at the crease. Mathews looked uncomfortable playing at that and could only pull towards the leg side. No run.

OUT! Nelson strikes! End of a brilliant knock by Kusal Perera but he is looking disappointed. We can understand that. With plenty of overs left, he surely would have loved to get a double here. Sarkar continues to be the partnership breaker for Bangladesh. Nothing too great with the delivery. It's full and angling in on middle, Perera tries to swing it over mid-wicket but it takes the inner half of his blade and flies straight into the hands of Mustafizur Rahman at short fine leg. This stand lasted exactly 100 runs. With the centurion gone, Bangladesh would like to pull things back from hereon.
The next batsman in for the Lankans is Angelo Mathews.
Slower yorker outside off stump, Perera makes room to drive it through cover but misses it altogether.
Another full ball outside off stump, Mendis drives it towards cover for a single.
Yorker on the stumps, Mendis does well to block it out.
Play and a miss! Perera goes for a wild slog sleep to this good length ball outside off. The bat is nowhere near the ball. Looks like Perera is getting impatient.
Another short one on the off pole. Perera rocks back onto the back foot and tries to cut. He mistimes it and gets an inside edge on it as the ball rolls towards point.
Short ball just outside off, Mendis cuts it towards deep point for a single.
Tossed up outside off stump, Mendis blocks it out.
On the middle pole, Mendis flicks it towards square leg for a couple of runs.
Perera comes down the track to this good length ball and pushes it towards long on to take a single.
Mahmudullah is on now.
Slower ball outside off, Mendis looks to defend but it goes back to the keeper on the bounce off the lower half of his bat.
Short delivery over the batsman's head, Perera makes room and attempts to pull it towards the leg side but can only get an inside edge for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off stump, Mendis cuts hard towards deep cover. A single taken.
Full on off, Perera strokes it down to long off for a single.
Good length delivery on middle pole, Mendis flicks it away to square leg for a single.
Shortish on length on middle, Mendis pushes it to mid-wicket fielder where he cleans up. No run.

Short ball on the off pole. Mendis pulls it straight down the ground and takes a single. The Lankans are in a great position here to go for a huge score. They have scored 198 with 8 wickets still to go and Perera on song.

Drinks Break! We have a slight delay as Mustafizur is struggling with cramp. The umpires have in fact called for Drinks here. Sri Lanka coasting along nicely here. The two Kusals have played brilliantly here. The duo have added a 90-run stand with Perera registering his 5th ODI fifty in the process. Luck too has gone their way as Mendis was put down by Mahmudullah. Bangladesh need to find a way to break this partnership. They look out of ideas here but a wicket will change the mood in the field.
Short around off, Perera strokes it to point for a single.

Good running by the Lankans and bad fielding by Bangladesh. Perera comes on the front foot to the full ball and pushes it towards mid-wicket. Perera sets off for a quick single and puts Hasan under pressure. He has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. The Bangladeshi fielders are late to provide the back-up following the throw and it results in an extra run.
Comes down the track to reach to the pitch of the ball, Perera pushes it towards deep mid-wicket and takes a couple.
Floated ball on leg pole, Kusal pushes it back to the bowler.
Short ball on off pole, Perera cuts it to the point fielder.
Mehedi Hasan is back into the attack. Hold on a minute, Tamim has once again given the ball back to Mosaddek Hossain.
Full delivery on off stump, Perera drives it straight down the ground for a single.
Back of a length delivery, Perera cuts hard but cannot go past the point fielder. No run taken.
Full on off, Mendis pushes it to the left of mid on. The fielder there misfields allowing them to take a single.
Slower ball bouncer from Soumya. Perera jumps up and pulls it to deep square leg to take another single.
Full on off, Mendis flicks this to deep mid-wicket and follows the boundary with a single.

FOUR! Poor ball from Sarkar. It was on a short length which did not rise high enough and certainly not enough to trouble Mendis. Kusal just rocks back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary. Good start to the over for Sri Lanka. Mendis moves on to 33.

Floated ball on off pole, pushed back off the back foot towards the bowler by Perera. Just a boundary off the over but the important thing for the Lankans is that Perera has completed his ton. The pressure is off him now.
Comes down the track to this good length ball, plays it towards the cover fielder.

FOUR! Perera gets to his hundred in style. Mosaddek tosses it up on middle, Perera gets down on one knee and sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary to bring up his 5th ODI ton. He removes his helmet and raises his bat as he soaks in all the applause. This has been a great knock from the southpaw. He has given Malinga a nice moment to cherish in Lasith's last ODI.
Full ball on off, Perera pushes it to the cover fielder off the front foot.
Presents the full face of the bat to this full ball outside off.
Flat on off pole, Perera plays it towards point.
Good length delivery on middle stump, Mendis flicks it towards mid-wicket. No run available. Good over from Sarkar. Only two runs from it.
BOUNCER! Good one from Sarkar. It goes above the head of Mendis and he leaves it alone.
Good length delivery on off stump, Perera pushes it to mid off and take off for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the stumps but Perera is well in.

DROPPED! Kusal Mendis has been given a lifeline by Mahmudullah. The man with the golden arm almost struck again. Sarkar bowls a short ball on off, Mendis goes for the pull. He does not time it well and it goes towards deep mid-wicket. Mahmudullah runs across in front and puts in a dive. He is unable to grasp that in though.
Good length on middle, Mendis defends it towards mid on.
Short delivery on off stump, Mendis pushes it the cover fielder. No run.
On the pads of Mendis, he gets down on one knee again and pulls it towards the deep square leg fielder for a single.
Good length ball on middle, Perera cuts it towards deep cover point and takes a single.

SIX! Excellent shot from Perera. It is short outside off, Perera picks the length early and smacks it over mid-wicket. There is no one in the deep there so not a risk. The ball just about hits the ropes on the full and it has been signalled as a six. Moves into the nervous 90s with that.
Shortish and on the off side for Perera, he cuts it but finds the point fielder.
This is shorter than the last one, Mendis gets down on one knee and pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Flatter on off, Mendis pushes it towards the off side.
Full on off, Perera blocks it off the front foot. Good start from Sarkar. Just a run off it.
Hat-trick of slower balls here. It is full on off, Perera hits it towards cover off the outer half of his bat.
Another slower one. It is on the pads, Perera looks to flick but misses. The ball hits him on the pads. There is a stifled appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Off cutter and full on off, Perera pushes it to mid off.
Good length ball outside off, Mendis punches it towards deep cover for a single.
Starts with a full ball on middle, Mendis defends it off the front foot.
Now Soumya Sarkar is into the attack. He was all set to bowl the previous over but at the last moment it was given to Mosaddek Hossain.
Flatter delivery on middle, Perera blocks it off the front foot back to the bowler. 4 runs came off the over.
Shortish on length outside off stump, Mendis hangs back and cuts it to the deep cover fielder for a single.
Tossed up on off, Perera nudges it to long on for a single.
Loop delivery on the pads, Mendis flicks it towards mid-wicket for another single.
Shorter in length, Perera pushes it to cover and take off for a quick single.
Fuller delivery on off stump, Perera defends it to third man.
Well, what has happened there? Soumya Sarkar was all set to bowl but then he is taken off. It will be Mosaddek Hossain to bowl.
Good running by the Lankans! Length ball on off, Mendis pushes this one towards backward point. The batters set off for the first one quickly and complete the second one as well.

FOUR! Not off the middle but Mendis won't mind. Rubel bends his back on this one. He bowls it short on off, Mendis goes for the pull but ends up edging it towards the vacant fine leg region  for a boundary.
On the pads again, Perera flicks it towards fine leg for a single.

FOUR! The 50-run partnership is up with this boundary and it has come in quick time as well, off just 45 balls. It was a length ball on the hips of Perera and he just helps it down to the fine leg fence for four runs. The Lankans would want this partnership to continue.
Full length ball on middle and off, Perera pushes it towards the cover fielder.
Length ball on leg, Perera pushes it back to the bowler.

FOUR! 150 up for the Lankans. Too easy for Mendis. It was another short ball from Mustafizur but Mendis just rocks back and pulls it towards the square leg fielder for the second boundary of the over. It was just asking to be hit and Mendis obliges. Partnership moves to 46. Poor over from Rahman comes to an end.
Short delivery outside off stump, Kusal guides it to third man for a single.
Bouncer! Mustafizur follows the full ball with a short one. It is on off, Perera sways away from it.
Full on middle and off, Perera smartly follows the boundary with a push back to the bowler.

FOUR! SHOT! Mustafizur bowls a very short delivery outside off stump but Perera is ready for it and cuts it over the cover fielder's head for a boundary. Somya Sarkar runs in from deep cover and makes a valiant effort to stop the boundary but the ball goes past him.

Great work in the deep. Sarkar saves a run for his side. Back of a length ball on off, Mendis pulls it wide of deep mid-wicket. Sarkar runs left and puts in a dive to save the ball from going to the fence. The batsmen meanwhile comeback for the third.
Fuller on middle and off, Perera punches it off the front foot towards cover. The fielder in the deep gives it a chase and cuts it off before reaching the ropes. The batters take a couple.
Mendis cuts this length ball towards deep backward point. The batters cross for a run.
Length ball on off, Mendis flicks it towards mid-wicket.
This one is on the hips of Perera, he tucks it towards square leg a for one.
Short of a length ball outside off, Mendis cuts it towards deep point for a single.
Good length ball on middle, Perera opens his bat and plays it towards cover point for a single.
Bouncer to end the over. It is around the body, Mendis ducks under it.
Another bouncer. This time Perera pulls it in a controlled manner towards deep square leg for a single.
Better line and length from Mustafizur. Full on off and middle, Perera flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.

EDGED AND FOUR! Mustafizur bangs it in short on off, Perera goes for the pull but ends up getting a top edge which flies over the keeper's head. You cannot keep a fielder there and it races away after a couple of bounces to the fence. Sometimes this game is cruel on the bowler's and this was one such occasion.

Direct hit and Mendis was a goner! Good length ball on off and middle, Mendis tucks it towards square leg and goes for a quick single. Mustafizur gets to the ball quickly and has a shy at the bowler's end. He does not hit the target though.
Good length ball around off, Perera strokes it towards cover and takes a single.
Similar line and length, again pushed to mid-wicket by Mendis. A good over for Bangladesh this, just a run off it.
Full ball on middle and leg, Mendis flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Full ball outside off, Mendis pushes it towards mid off.

Stifled appeal for an LBW by Bangladesh. It looks like the ball is going over the stumps. The ball pitches on off and nips back in, but hits him over the knee roll. The replay and ball tracker confirms that the ball is going over the wickets.
Similar line and length again, but this time Perera finds the gap and takes a single.
On a length just outside off, Perera plays it off the back foot towards covers.
Rubel Hossain is back into the attack now.
Short ball on leg stump, Mendis ducks and leaves it alone. It looked like a wide but there is no signal given from the umpire.
Good length delivery outside off stump, Mendis leaves it alone.
Short in length and outside off, Perera stands back and slaps it to deep cover for a run.

FOUR! Good batting from Perera. Short delivery on off stump, Perera rocks back and cuts it past the point fielder for a boundary. It did not look like it was going for a boundary but Kusal had timed it so well that it raced to the fence.
On a good length outside off stump, Mendis pushes it to third man for a single.
2 WIDES! Slower ball on the leg side, Perera tries to glance it but misses and the ball rolls on to the keeper who fails to collect it and the batsmen cross over for a single.
BOUNCER! Perera ducks under it and allows it to go back to the keeper.

FOUR! Great shot! Carves it through the off side and pierces the gap. This is floated and full on off by Hasan, Mendis takes a full stride forward and just punches it with grace in the gap at the cover region. The ball races away to the fence and Mendis ends the over on a good note for Sri Lanka.
Full ball on off, pushed towards deep cover for a single by Perera.

FOUR! Fine shot! Kusal Perera is so strong square of the wicket. Flatter and shorter around off, Kusal rocks back, delays his shot a bit and steers it behind square on the off side. Finds the gap and it races through, beating the diving attempt near deep backward point by Mohammad Mithun.
Full ball on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Shorter on middle and leg, Mendis plays it unorthodoxly towards square leg for a single.
Flat ball outside off, pushed off the back foot towards mid on.
Good length ball on off stump, Mendis guides it to third man to get off the mark.
Fuller on off stump, Mendis pushes it to cover for another dot.
Short ball on the body, Mendis rocks back and pushes it to square leg. No run.
Good length ball on off stump, Perera pushes it to deep cover for a single.
Short ball on middle stump, Perera does not time his pull and it goes straight to square leg. No run.
Short ball on off stump, Perera defends it back to the bowler.
Mustafizur Rahman is back into the attack now.

DRINKS! Sri Lanka are 107/2 with Karunaratne, the skipper the latest wicket to fall. They have laid a strong foundation for the middle order to come in and play according to their liking. Kusal Mendis is the new batsman.

OUT! Against the run of play, Bangladesh have a breakthrough. The Sri Lankan skipper departs after batting quite well. Floated full ball around off, gripping a bit and then turning away a shade. Karunaratne is down on one knee in an attempt to sweep but it takes the top edge and flies to short fine leg. Mustafizur Rahman settles underneath it and makes no mistake. The dangerous 97-run stand is broken.
Short and flat on off, Karunaratne goes onto the back foot and cuts but finds the backward point fielder.
Again flat just outside off, Dimuth pushes it towards mid off.
Full ball on off, played to the cover fielder.
Tossed up on off pole, pushed back to the bowler.
Flatter on off, punched down to long off for a run.
Change of ends for Mehedi Hasan.
Fullish and on off, Perera comes forward to drive straight but his bat turns in his hands and he gets it away off the inner half. The ball rolls to mid on and they cross.
WIDE! Bowled down the leg side and Kusal lets it go for a wide.

FOUR! 15th ODI fifty for Kusal Perera. Excellent innings from Kusal. It was on a good length on off stump and Perera prods forward and hits it past the mid off fielder for the second boundary of the over. Perera is looking really dangerous here.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Perera lets it go for a wide. 100 up for Sri Lanka
FOUR! Excellent shot from Kusal. Perera reaches on 49. It was a good length delivery and Perera dances down the track and hits it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Short ball outside off, Dimuth pushes it towards third man. A single is taken.
Good length ball outside leg stump, it hits the pads of Perera and goes towards the leg side. The batters cross for a leg bye.
Short ball outside off stump, Karunaratne under edges it to third man for a single
FOUR! Too full in length this time, on middle and leg, Kusal sits down on one knee and sweeps it sweetly behind square leg for a boundary.
Perera has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Yet another misfield. This is very dismal from Bangladesh. Dimuth stays back to push it to covers where the fielder allows it through. One more added to the total.
Once again the length is on the shorter side and Kusal forces it down to long off for one.
Stands back inside the crease to a short ball on middle and hits it towards extra cover. The fielder misfields and allows a run.
Quicker one, flat and on middle, it's pushed back in the direction of the bowler.
Karunaratne plays it off the back foot towards mid off, the batters cross for a single.
Good ball again. It pitches on a length on the fourth stump line, it nips back in. Dimuth plays at it but outside the line of the ball as it sneaks between the bat and the body.
This time misses his mark as this ball is on the pads. Perera clips it towards backward square leg for a single.
Third one in a row. Good bowling by Shafiul. He bowls it on a good length just outside off, this one swings away. Perera again tries to push at it but misses.

NOT OUT! Excellent delivery by Shafiul to begin with. He lands it on a length around off and takes it away with the angle. Perera goes nowhere with his footwork and tries to force it through the line. He misses and they appeal for a caught behind. The umpire has his finger raised but Kusal takes the DRS to get it overturned. Nothing on the Ultra Edge.
Review time! Kusal Perera has been adjudged caught behind. But he feels that he has not edged it and takes the DRS. Ultra Edge has found nothing much to the delight of the home crowd.
Play and a miss! Length ball on the fourth stump line, Perera tries to cut but misses.
Shafiul is back into the attack now.
Fires it on middle, again on the shorter side, Perera punches it from the crease, in front of square on the off side and keeps strike with a single.
Walks forward to a full ball and knocks it down through mid on for a run.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Perera moves back and punches it through covers for a run.
Flatter and outside off, Perera tries to cut but misses.
Rocks back and slaps it in the air but in the gap. It speeds to sweeper cover for a brace.
Full and outside off, stroked through mid off for a run.
Similar line and length, Perera again punches it towards the cover fielder. Bangladesh need to stop the flow of runs here.
Perera plays this full ball off the front foot towards the cover fielder.

FOUR! What a shot! Class personified by Perera. This time Rubel bowls it full and just outside off, perera gets on the front foot and just punches it between the cover and cover point fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! Pulled again. Rubel is not learning from his mistakes here. He again bowls it on the hips of Perera, he pulls it off the back foot towards the backward square leg region for a boundary.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Mushfiqur Rahim is in a considerable amount of pain. He seems to have hurt his fingers. Physio has come out to address the issue. Magic spray can do wonders here. Meanwhile, taking opportunity of this forced break, Tamim Iqbal has gathered his players in a huddle and is giving his boys some pep talk. The current partnership is going great guns and has put Bangladesh on the back foot.

5 Wides! Bad bowling by Rubel here. This is pitched way outside leg, Dimuth lets it go as he knows it's a wide. The ball moves in the air away from the keeper after pitching, Mushfiqur dives to his right but just gets a hand to it and is not able to save it from going towards the fence.
Length ball on middle and leg,  the batter plays it back to the bowler.
Rubel Hossain is back into the attack now.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
FOUR! Up and over! Nicely done. Tossed up outside off, Dimuth comes down the track and heaves it over mid-wicket!
Full and around off, driven straight back to the bowler.
FOUR! Great start to the over. Tossed up around middle, Karunaratne comes down the track and powers it past the non-striker through mid on!
Mosaddek Hossain into the attack now.
This time he stays in the crease and plays it back towards the bowler. Good batting by Sri Lanka here up until this point.
Perera gets down the ground and pushes this ball back towards off.
FOUR! Perera smashes it again! Shortish and flat wide outside off, Perera goes onto the back foot and plays the square cut. It pierces the gap and goes towards the point fence.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Kusal punches it from the back foot through the covers! 50 UP FOR SRI LANKA.
Comes down the track and looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Mehedi appeals but it is not entertained.
Full and around off, Karunaratne comes down the track and pushes it through mid on for a quick single.
Perera goes onto the back foot and pushes this off sided ball back towards mid off. No runs taken.
FOUR! Changes side but not his approach, Rubel. Again drifting onto the pads of Rubel, Perera stays back and smashes it towards fine leg for another boundary. Perera is not looking to go easy here!
FOUR! Pulls and pulls powerfully! On the hips of Perera by Rubel, he goes onto the back foot and pulls it behind square leg for a boundary.
On the body of Perera he blocks it out towards the leg side.
Again on the pads, this time Karunaratne plays it towards front of deep square leg for a single.
On the pads of Perera, he plays it towards the square leg fielder for a single.
Rubel Hossain is into the attack now. He his playing his 100th ODI today.
FOUR! Second boundary of the over! Full and around off, driven through mid off!
Comes down the track and eases it through mid on for a run.
FOUR! Short and outside off, cut through point for a boundary!
Down the leg side, Dimuth works it through square leg for a single.

Landed around off, Karunaratne plays the reverse sweep and gets it past short third man. Mahmudullah gets to it, slides and parries it back to Mustafizur Rahman coming behind him, with his left hand. Two runs taken.
Full and around off, solidly defended.
Shortish delivery on middle and leg by Islam, Perera pulls it but the fielder at short mid-wicket dives to his right and stops it. No runs taken.

FOUR! Great short by Kusal Perera. Islam pitches it on a good length just outside off. Perera comes down the ground a bit and punches this ball between the gap at point and cover point. The fielders give it the chase but the ball races away towards the fence.
Karunaratne flicks this good length ball towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Short of a length on off, Dimuth pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Length ball outside off by Shafiul, Karunaratne plays it towards cover point.
Wide! Way outside off this time by Shafiul. Wide signalled.

FOUR! Fullish ball outside off and Dimuth drives it towards the cover fielder where Sabbir Rahman is positioned. He is late to get down to his right and lets the ball past him which results in a boundary.
Full and around off, Kusal looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Action replay of the previous delivery.
Landed outside off, driven through mid off for an easy single.
Short and outside off, punched straight to cover.
Around middle and leg, worked towards square leg. Kusal wants the single but is sent back.
Full and outside off, driven down to long off for a single.
The ball is on a good length, Kusal plays defends it off the front foot. end of a succesful over for Bangladesh. Sri Lanka are 10/1.
Kusal Perera is the new man in.

OUT! Caught! Edged and gone! Fernando is a goner. Soft wicket given away by Sri Lanka. This ball was short of a length outside off, Fernando slashes at it but gets just an outside edge at it. The ball flies towards the 1st slip where Soumya Sarkar takes an easy catch. Sri Lanka have lost their 1st wicket.
Bowled on the middle pole and the ball angles away from the left-hander, Dimuth guides it towards third man for a single.
Good length ball just outside off, Fernando plays it with soft hands towards mid on for one.
Good length ball on the off pad, Fernando clips it towards mid-wicket for a couple.

NOT OUT. Missing the leg stump and Sri Lanka lose their review pretty early. A length ball outside off, Fernando looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Shafiul appeals but it is not entertained. He gets Tamim in his ears and the skipper signals for the review. Hawk Eye shows it to be missing leg.
LBW review! Has Shafiul struck here? He reckons that Avishka is LBW. Looks to be missing leg...
Flat ball on off, Dimuth blocks it out.
Full and flat on middle and leg, Fernando plays it towards mid on for a single.
Uppish but safe. Hasan tosses this one up and Dimuth plays for the faster ball. He mistimes it as the ball is chipped towards mid off. Luckily for Sri Lanka, there was no fielder in that region.
Full on off stump, Fernando plays it to mid on for a single.
Flat on off pole, Fernando plays it back to the bowler.
Flat on off pole, Karunaratne is off the mark as he plays it towards covers and takes a single.
Spin from the other end. Mehedi Hasan to bowl with the second new ball.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

LEADING EDGE, SAFE! A length ball outside off, AF looks to tuck it to the leg side but gets defeated by the extra bounce. The ball hits the top half of the bat and goes over the bowler and is not carrying to mid off!
No swing and slip had disappeared.
Sri Lanka are away. A length ball outside off, Avishka looks to flick but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat through square leg. A couple taken.
Full and wide outside off, left alone.
Slightly fuller, watchfully kept out.
On a length outside off, coming in, solidly defended.
The anthems are done and dusted, the play is set to begin. The Sri Lankan openers Avishka Fernando and Dimuth Karunaratneare out on the pitch. Shafiul Islam to start the proceedings for Bangladesh.
The national anthems are in progress with Bangladeshi national anthem up first.

Bangladesh skipper, Tamim Iqbal, stays that he would have batted first as well. But now, he wants to bowl well and restrict the Lankans to as low a score as possible. On missing Shakib and Mortaza, Tamim agrees that they are missing a couple of key players but also adds that the 15-man squad is very potent. On the mindset for this series, Tamim says that they were lucky to get the warm-up match and believes that they can do their job. Playing XI - Tamim Iqbal(C), Soumya Sarkar, Mohammad Mithun, Mushfiqur Rahim(WK), Mahmudullah, Mosaddek Hossain, Sabbir Rahman, Mehedi Hasan, Rubel Hossain, Shafiul Islam, Mustafizur Rahman.

Sri Lankan skipper, Dimuth Karunaratne, says that the wicket looks a good one to bat upon and will seam around in the night. Adds that they are playing four fast bowlers and will like to make full use of the conditions. Believes that the players have the self-belief to play well and win and get their confidence back. On Malinga, Dimuth says that he has been a great player and Sri lanka are lucky to have had him. Playing XI - Dimuth Karunaratne(C), Kusal Perera(WK), Avishka Fernando, Kusal Mendis, Angelo Mathews, Lahiru Thirimanne, Dhananjaya de Silva, Thisara Perera, Nuwan Pradeep, Lahiru Kumara, Lasith Malinga.
TOSS - Time for the spin of the coin. Dimuth Karunaratne has it in his hand, he flips it, Heads is the call, but it is a Tail. SRI LANKA ELECT TO BAT!

Good afternoon and a warm welcome to the R. Premadasa stadium in Colombo, Sri Lanka. We are here to cover the 1st match between Bangladesh and Sri Lanka. The weather seems overcast and we can expect showers. However, the highlight of the day will be the farewell for the golden-haired pacer, Lasith Malinga who will be playing his last ODI match for his nation. Sri Lanka will be looking to give their hero a winning farewell and as for Bangladesh, they will be looking to take the lead in the 3-match series and stake a strong claim of winning their first ODI series on Sri Lankan soil. Bangladesh is led by stand-in skipper Tamim Iqbal as Mashrafe Murtaza is out injured with a calf strain. Another notable absentee for Bangladesh is probably the best all-rounder of the world, Shakib Al Hasan. Bangladesh will be hoping that their absence is not felt too much.
